summary: Ported the complete opt-in BWAP proposal onto the prepared main checkout, including per-request adaptive scheduling, masked fallback, TP=1 unquantized fused gathered GEMMs, adaptive decode CUDA-graph buffer refresh, CLI/config integration, documentation, and regression tests. Verified native ROCm arithmetic and real eager/graph serving with the qualified deterministic tiny Llama fixture. This is a verified implementation candidate, not a semantic-accuracy or production-throughput qualification.

tests.what_was_measured: 20 unit tests plus 3 adversarial subtests covering score equations, exact top-k cardinality, per-request and mixed-batch scheduling, activation-hook behavior, fused/masked equivalence, fixed-address buffers, graph gating, defaults, and invalid option combinations.

tests.command: pinned Python GPU numerical script recorded in evidence/gpu/numerical.txt
tests.what_was_measured: On AMD Instinct MI355X, compared the native SGLang SiluAndMul ROCm kernel and every BWAP gathered-GEMM variant against an independent pure-PyTorch dense masked formula. Maximum absolute error was 0 for native/fused/into and 0.0009765625 for the fully pool-free path.
Real source-checkout eager serving on the assigned GPU: /generate, OpenAI completion, two-request batch, and streaming all returned HTTP 200; both Llama MLP layers selected the fused path.

tests.command: qualified run_server_probe.py with decode graph batch sizes 1,2 and --enable-bwap --bwap-fused --bwap-sparsity 0.5 --bwap-t-init 1 --bwap-t-explore 1 --bwap-t-prune 2
tests.what_was_measured: Real adaptive CUDA-graph serving on the assigned GPU: batch sizes 1 and 2 captured, four graph-resident buffers registered, repeated 64-of-128 mask refreshes observed, and all four HTTP probes returned 200.
Repository formatting, lint, syntax, secret, merge-conflict, and registered-test checks for all changed source/test/report files.

gpu_execution.evidence: AMD Instinct MI355X (gfx950), Torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2 / HIP 7.2.26015. See evidence/gpu/numerical.txt and evidence/serving/{eager,graph}/server.log.

remaining_limitations: The qualified tiny Llama has deterministic random weights. It validates transport, engine execution, fused FFN selection, and adaptive graph refresh only; it cannot establish semantic accuracy.
No suitable 1.5B/7B model weights or GSM8K corpus were available, so the proposal's accuracy claims and accuracy-versus-sparsity tradeoff were not independently reproduced.
No production-sized model throughput benchmark was run. Tiny-model request latency is dominated by overhead and is not evidence of a BWAP speedup.

The fused fast path remains intentionally limited to unquantized floating-point, bias-free gated MLPs at TP=1. Quantized layers, bias-bearing layers, and TP>1 use the correct masking fallback without compute savings; global cross-TP top-k is unimplemented.
The gathered weights and capture scratch buffers retain the proposal's substantial extra memory overhead.

Eager and graph output IDs matched for the isolated single-request probes. In the later two-request probe they differed in a few tail tokens after prior requests had adapted the shared masks; the random fixture cannot distinguish benign low-precision sensitivity from model-quality impact.
No native C++ or FlyDSL source changed, so no native rebuild was applicable. The installed ROCm SGLang kernel was exercised directly on GPU.
